_note: Arrow wounds on mudcrabs: shafts wedged in the shell, pale fluid. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point cracking into the shell with a sharp snap. The shaft sticks fast and {name} clacks and scuttles back.
, the arrowhead wedging into shell that is already cracked. It splits further and pale fluid seeps around the shaft; {name} snaps wildly.
, and the arrow punches through the broken shell. Fluid spurts and {name} thrashes, legs scrabbling.
, and it is too much. {name} sinks flat, arrows standing from the shell, legs curling, fluid pooling beneath.
